items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: opening up of the American ear by Gershwin, Cole Porter, that’s it.

ctx.x: A lot more than race or some kind of purposeful artistic mission. I mean it was the opening up of the American ear by Gershwin, Cole Porter, that’s it. I mean that’s it. That’s the way I feel.

Okay. Great statement. It’s going to give me some food for thought for sure. Yeah there’s an awful lot of statements made about what jazz players were intending to do and their role in society and all that, and maybe it’s not that complicated.
